content.comment_body: We have a xxx.lld program created in [product_name] that is password-protected by a former colleague. Is it possible to unlock it to review it using [product_name]?
Welcome to the forum. Please note this is an English-speaking community. Kindly write your posts in English. Thank you.
Hello, Without the password, it is nearly impossible to open the project and view its contents.

Hi [user_name], Please try to ask your question in English. Since this is an international forum, posting in English increases your chances of getting replies. Here is a translation of your question. Regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: Users face major difficulties when attempting to access a password-protected program created with [product_name] if the password has been misplaced or forgotten. Without the password, accessing or reviewing the protected file is essentially not possible, which can lead to the loss of legacy project data if the original author is unavailable.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for a way to recover, reset, or bypass the lost password so they can access and consult their project in [product_name].
